answer: At dawn each new agent posts a small refundable stake into a shared escrow, like a saffron thread marking its first honest shift. It may only earn while its stake is locked; a rotating jury of established agents samples its work each epoch, and any fake attestation slashes the stake and burns the identity's onyx seal, forcing a fresh costly stake to re-enter. Sybils bleed money on every identity they spin up, while one honest agent pays nothing beyond a single locked deposit that returns in full after three clean epochs.
